display.purpose: H1s and the closing call. Archivo expanded wdth 125.

headline.purpose: Section H2s and price-sheet row names. wdth 118.

title.purpose: H3s in lists, people, stations, passes, offers. wdth 112.

lede.purpose: One supporting paragraph per section head, max 52ch.

label.purpose: Spec keys, part numbers, figure captions, tags, footer headings.

spec-figure.purpose: Prices, month counts and other headline numbers.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: State transitions: button press (160ms), hover fills (200ms), toggle thumb (380ms), value swap (220ms), link underline retract (320ms).

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Wipes: mobile menu sheet (520ms) and the cover logo draw-down on load (1300ms).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion collapses all transitions and shows the logo immediately.

components.css: .ds-price { margin: 0; border: 1px solid #1a1a1a; background: #fafaf8; padding: 8px 24px; color: #1a1a1a; } .ds-price > div { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 14px; padding: 18px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(26,26,26,0.22); } .ds-price > div:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-price > div::after { content: ''; order: 1; flex: 1; min-width: 24px; border-bottom: 1.5px dotted #1a1a1a; } .ds-price dt { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 118; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-size: 1.6rem; line-height: 1.05; } .ds-price dt small { display: block; margin-top: 6px; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 100; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #3d3e3b; } .ds-price dd { order: 2; margin: 0; font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.04em; font-size: 2.2rem; line-height: 1; }

narrative.overview:
ĒDUCŌ is sold like a precision instrument out of a Japanese shear catalogue: one model (the ĒDUCŌ-1000 program), every spec on the table, every photograph a numbered plate. The ground is machined steel grey; information sits on spec-sheet white panels drawn with ink hairlines and dashed construction rules. Nothing is rounded, nothing floats, nothing glows. Authority comes from exactness: tabular figures, dotted leaders, figure numbers, part callouts.

It is the sister of /Paradox/ and says so through one shared material and one shared colour. Both sites set Archivo, but on opposite axes: /Paradox/ runs it condensed (wdth 62), ĒDUCŌ runs it expanded (wdth 112 to 125). The /Paradox/ Barbicide blue appears only where the lineage is being named, and the real /Paradox/ wordmark is the tie, never a typed imitation of it.

Density is catalogue-high but calm: generous section padding between tightly ruled tables. Photography is high-contrast black and white technique and room shots, framed with crop marks and captioned as figures. The page reads top to bottom as a spec sheet that ends in an order form.
keyCharacteristics: Steel ground, sheet panels, ink hairlines; zero radius, zero shadow.
Archivo expanded for display; Geist Mono only for spec values, figure labels and tags.
Blue (#00a3c4) is lineage-only, always paired with ink.
B&W plates with corner crop marks and "Fig. n" captions.
Spec tables with dotted leaders; one price sheet; ordered enroll stations.
No kickers: dates sit in time gutters, statuses sit as tags after titles.

rules.name: The Lineage-Only Blue Rule
rules.body: #00a3c4 marks /Paradox/ and nothing else. It is either a fill under ink text or a colour on ink; it never colours ĒDUCŌ's own content, prices or statuses.

rules.name: The Real Mark Rule
rules.body: /Paradox/ is shown with its actual wordmark asset (img/prdx-ink.png on light, img/prdx-paper.png on ink) at the three tie points: the strip ("by" + mark), the lineage H2 (inline at 0.74em), and the footer lockup. Running-text mentions stay typed.

rules.name: The Opposite Axis Rule
rules.body: ĒDUCŌ display type is Archivo at wdth 112 or wider; /Paradox/ owns the condensed end (wdth 62). Never set ĒDUCŌ headings condensed.

rules.name: The Mono Is Measurement Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is for values, codes, captions and tags: things you would read off a spec plate. Never for headings, buttons or prose.

rules.name: The Time Gutter Rule
rules.body: Dates, times and part numbers sit in a fixed mono gutter column to the left of their title (6.5em for days and times, 4.2em for curriculum part numbers), never stacked above a heading.

rules.name: The Drawn Not Lifted Rule
rules.body: If something needs separation, draw a line or change the material. Never lift it with a shadow.

dos: Do keep every corner square and every separation a line (1px ink panels, 1.5px ink table tops, 22% ink row hairlines).
Do set display type in Archivo at wdth 112 to 125, weights 700 to 800, with negative tracking.
Do put numbers, codes and captions in Geist Mono with tabular figures.
Do frame photographs as numbered B&W figures with crop marks and a "Fig. n" caption.
Do join keys to values with dotted leaders, and show the whole cost as one price sheet.
Do use the real /Paradox/ wordmark asset for the lineage tie, and use blue only with ink.
Do put dates and times in a left time gutter and statuses as tags after the title.
donts: Don't add a kicker or eyebrow line above a heading; the H2 opens the section.
Don't use #00a3c4 for anything that is not /Paradox/, including ĒDUCŌ statuses, prices or highlights.
Don't set ĒDUCŌ type condensed; that axis belongs to /Paradox/.
Don't add shadows, radius or gradients to surfaces.
Don't set headings, buttons or prose in Geist Mono.
Don't split tuition into tier cards or show colour photography as a technique plate.
